key.name: toggle-bar
key.description: Keyboard shortcut used to expand or collapse the dynamic bar.

key.name: handle-width
key.description: Width of the dynamic bar in pixels.

key.name: bar-long-width
key.description: Width of the dynamic bar while hovered or expanded, in pixels.

key.name: handle-height
key.description: Height of the dynamic bar in pixels.

key.name: handle-radius
key.description: Corner radius of the dynamic bar in pixels.

key.name: handle-gap
key.description: Gap between the panel (or dynamic island) and the dynamic bar in pixels.

key.name: handle-alpha
key.description: Opacity of the dynamic bar.

key.name: handle-hover-alpha
key.description: Opacity of the dynamic bar while hovered.

key.name: bar-track-alpha
key.description: Opacity of the progress track while the bar is active.

key.name: bar-progress-alpha
key.description: Opacity of the progress fill while the bar is active.

key.name: panel-width
key.description: Minimum width of the dynamic island in pixels.

key.name: panel-height
key.description: Minimum height of the dynamic island in pixels.

key.name: card-page-width
key.description: Shared compact width for persistent island pages.

key.name: card-page-edge-padding
key.description: Extra horizontal inset added to every island page.

key.name: panel-top-radius
key.description: Radius of the concave corner where the dynamic island meets the top bar.

key.name: panel-bottom-radius
key.description: Radius of the bottom corners of the dynamic island.

key.name: island-padding
key.description: Padding around the dynamic island content in pixels.

key.name: compact-control-height
key.description: Shared height for thin island controls and page navigation, in pixels.

key.name: maximized-dark-color
key.description: Opaque island background used for maximized windows in dark style.

key.name: maximized-light-color
key.description: Opaque island background used for maximized windows in light style.

key.name: hover-duration
key.description: Duration of the bar hover animation in milliseconds.

key.name: expand-duration
key.description: Duration of the expand animation in milliseconds.

key.name: collapse-duration
key.description: Duration of the collapse animation in milliseconds.

key.name: auto-collapse-delay
key.description: Collapse automatically after the pointer leaves the bar for this many milliseconds. 0 disables it.

key.name: notification-decay
key.description: How long transient notifications (charging, lock keys) stay expanded, in milliseconds.

key.name: track-flash-duration
key.description: How long the music note indicator stays visible on track changes, in milliseconds.

key.name: activity-dot-size
key.description: Diameter of the activity dot in pixels. 0 matches the dynamic bar height.

key.name: activity-dot-hit-size
key.description: Reactive area around an activity dot used for near-hover growth, in pixels.

key.name: activity-dot-hover-scale
key.description: Scale applied to an activity dot after the pointer lingers nearby.

key.name: activity-dot-border-width
key.description: Width of the outer ring on completed activity dots, in pixels.

key.name: activity-auto-remove
key.description: Remove terminal activities after the configured expiry delay.

key.name: activity-expiry-seconds
key.description: Seconds before a completed activity is automatically removed.

key.name: list-progress-height
key.description: Logical-pixel progress thickness for activity, timer and device rows.

key.name: bar-media-color
key.description: Dynamic bar media progress color.

key.name: bar-media-striped
key.description: Draw media progress with stripes.

key.name: bar-activity-color
key.description: Dynamic bar generic activity color.

key.name: bar-activity-striped
key.description: Draw generic activities with stripes.

key.name: bar-timer-color
key.description: Dynamic bar timer color.

key.name: bar-timer-striped
key.description: Draw timers with stripes.

key.name: bar-device-color
key.description: Dynamic bar device color.

key.name: bar-device-striped
key.description: Draw device metrics with stripes.

key.name: activity-running-color
key.description: Color of running activity dots and progress fills.

key.name: activity-success-color
key.description: Color of completed activity dots and progress fills.

key.name: activity-paused-color
key.description: Color of paused activity dots and progress fills.

key.name: activity-warning-color
key.description: Color of warning and orphaned activity dots and progress fills.

key.name: activity-error-color
key.description: Color of error and cancelled activity dots and progress fills.

key.name: small-notification-height
key.description: Height of the low-profile small notifications in pixels.

key.name: small-notification-font-size
key.description: Font size of the small notification label in pixels.

key.name: removable-mounted-color
key.description: Outer ring color for a readable mounted volume activity dot.

key.name: removable-unmounted-color
key.description: Outer ring color for a removed or unreadable volume activity dot.

key.name: animations-enabled
key.description: Animate dynamic island and dynamic bar transitions.

key.name: launcher-apps
key.description: Desktop file ids shown as buttons in the dynamic island launcher, separated by commas.

key.name: launcher-items
key.description: JSON configuration for launcher names, icons, commands and desktop actions.

key.name: media-enabled
key.description: Show media playback progress on the dynamic bar and media controls in the island.

key.name: notifications-enabled
key.description: Allow this extension to show transient notifications.

key.name: notification-forwarding-enabled
key.description: Show a small notification when GNOME receives a notification.

key.name: notification-filter
key.description: Application IDs excluded from notification forwarding.

key.name: printing-enabled
key.description: Show visible CUPS print jobs and printer problems.

key.name: bluetooth-enabled
key.description: Notify when a Bluetooth device connects or disconnects.

key.name: charging-enabled
key.description: Expand the island when the battery starts charging.

key.name: lock-keys-enabled
key.description: Show lock key state on the bar and expand the island when a lock key changes.

key.name: battery-low-threshold
key.description: Show a charging notification when the battery drops to this percentage.
